row: Wetheriggs is a small animal rescue centre based at Thorpe Farm near Barnard Castle in County Durham, UK. We are open every day from 10am to public and just ask for a small admission fee to support our rescue work. Visitors can get close to our animals and feed a lot of them. We often have animal handling sessions with small furries, chicks, ducklings, reptiles and more. We are a registered UK charity (1131536) and depend on public support to keep running. Come and check us out www.wetheriggs.co.uk
